<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">The proposed
     development, by reason of failure to provide a sufficient lighting Impact
     Assessment, would give rise to potentially unacceptable harmful visual
     impacts, disturbance and nuisance impacts as a result of light pollution,
     to the detriment of the residential amenities of the adjacent neighbouring
     occupiers. As such, the development is contrary to the National Planning
     Policy Framework (2023), policies D3, D.7 and D13 of the London Plan (2021)
     and policies DM 1 and DM 48 of the Harrow Development Management Policies
     Local Plan (2013).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></li>
</ol>

<span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The proposed development, by reason of an insufficient Ecological Assessment including assessment of flood lighting impacts, microplastics mitigation, assessment of potential protected species and the wider ecological impacts on the quality of the environment, fails to demonstrate that the proposal would not cause harm to the biodiversity value of the adjoining Canons Park Borough Grade II Site of Importance for Nature Conservation and the Edgware Brook corridor, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), policy G6 of the London Plan (2021), and policies DM 48, DM 20 and DM 21 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).</span></span>
description: Replacement of existing three (3) grass pitches with artificial turf  sports pitches, installation of floodlighting and fencing, and associated works.
